title: Essential: Final coil currents
description: Essential Criteria: States that the required proton coil currents are i'_n = -35.0 i_n (or equivalent numerical factor).

title: Essential: Resolving power factor
description: Essential Criteria: States that the resolving power increases by a factor of 35 (or equivalent ratio).

title: Important: Momentum ratio derivation
description: Important Criteria: Correctly applies relativistic energy-momentum relation to find p'/p = 1/35 (or p/p' = 35).

title: Important: Magnetic field scaling
description: Important Criteria: Derives that the required magnetic field scales as B' = -(p'/p) B to maintain the same trajectory.

title: Important: Current-field proportionality
description: Important Criteria: Recognizes that coil current is proportional to the magnetic field (i.e., B ∝ i) for the same geometry.

title: Optional: Relativistic energy consideration
description: Optional Criteria: Explicitly notes that the electron is highly relativistic (K=E_e) while the proton is non-relativistic.

title: Optional: De Broglie wavelength link
description: Optional Criteria: Connects resolving power to de Broglie wavelength (λ = h/p) and thus to momentum.

title: Pitfall: Sign error in currents
description: Pitfall Criteria: Fails to include the negative sign indicating reversed current direction for the proton.

title: Pitfall: Non-relativistic assumption
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly uses non-relativistic kinematics for the electron's momentum.
